scope.strong_uptrend: MC65-80; existing leader recognition/shallow candidates; new work is exit/context only
scope.good_market: MC50-65; existing shallow candidates; new work is exit/context only
scope.standard_correction: MC35-50 exact split; new M10 RSI60 and M21 RSI55 comparison
scope.recovery: MC20-35; no duplicate retest; rely on completed RSI30/market-RS189 studies
scope.panic: MC<20; no duplicate retest; rely on completed RSI30/TQQQ panic studies

exit_methods.FIX20: exit at open 20 sessions after entry
exit_methods.FIX40: exit at open 40 sessions after entry
exit_methods.EMA10: first close below EMA10 -> next open, max 60
exit_methods.EMA21: first close below EMA21 -> next open, max 60
exit_methods.ATR3: close below highest-close minus 3 ATR14 -> next open, max 60
exit_methods.P25_AT20_EMA10: sell 25% next open after first close >=+20%; remainder EMA10 trail, max 60
exit_methods.FAST20_EXTEND21: if +20% within first 15 sessions, extend to EMA21/max40; otherwise fixed20

execution: signal at close, next-open execution for dynamic exits; 5 bps each side
limitations: Daily OHLC cannot resolve intraday order beyond next-open rules.
NOW is a leader-recognition benchmark, not the exact historical production normal-stock ledger.
